adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the CalDAV/iCal `createEvent` logic was updated to derive `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and then filters available calendars using only that first element’s `externalId` (`c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId`). Given this PR changes `destinationCalendar` to an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now creates events per-destination/credential, using only `destinationCalendar[0]` will select the wrong calendar for non-first destinations in multi-host/collective scenarios (likely creating multiple events into the same first calendar). The part about "ignores the new credentialId param" isn’t directly verifiable from the shown diff hunk (the method signature isn’t visible here), but the first-element-only selection is clearly present and breaks the intended multi-destination behavior.
